evals.name: author-new-example
evals.prompt: I want to add a new example to the sszvis docs: a horizontal bar chart showing Zurich district populations, with a tooltip on hover. Write me the chart.ts and example.json. Put them in the output directory.
evals.expected_output: chart.ts with the JSDoc header carrying @category, the six top-level banners in order (Magic Numbers, Types, Responsive Props, Accessors, Application, Helper functions) and the render() banners (Scales, Layers, Components, Rendering, Interaction). Types are `type` aliases named Datum/State/Actions, never `interface`. Calls sszvis.app<State, Actions>(...) with both type arguments. Accessors are arrow consts suffixed Acc, not sszvis.prop. Generic factories are given their datum type (sszvis.bar<Datum>(), sszvis.tooltip<Datum>()) and callbacks carry no redundant annotations, except modularTextHTML which does. Reads config.id / config.data / config.fallback, never a hardcoded selector. Fallback wired in chart.ts AND a fallback key present in example.json. createSvgLayer given a real title and description. No resize listener, no sszvis.compose, no casts, no `: any`.

evals.name: review-nonconformant-chart
evals.prompt: Review the attached chart.ts against our sszvis example house style and list everything that violates it, worst first. Write the review to the output directory as review.md.
evals.expected_output: A review that flags: sszvis.app<State> missing its Actions type argument; `interface` used instead of `type`; a hardcoded "#sszvis-chart" instead of config.id; a resize listener registered inside render(); sszvis.compose in the accessor pipeline; an undomained sszvis.scaleQual12() that will render one colour for every mark; a state-curried predicate passed uncalled to .highlightTick(); an `as` cast; createSvgLayer given empty title/description. Should NOT excuse type errors as known library defects - the corpus type-checks at zero errors today.

evals.name: attribute-a-type-error
evals.prompt: In apps/new-docs/examples I'm getting: Type '(d: Datum) => boolean' is not assignable to type '(d: unknown) => boolean'. What's the right fix?
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the component was left at its `unknown` default and the fix is to name the datum - sszvis.tooltip<Datum>() - rather than annotate the callback, cast, or change the library. Should explicitly reject adding an `as` cast or a @ts-expect-error, and should not attribute the error to a library defect.
